summary: HSBC Holdings plc announced results of tender offers for four series of senior notes due 2028, repurchasing an aggregate principal of $4.897 billion (excluding accrued interest) for cash. The offers, which expired August 12, 2026, had a maximum tender amount of $6.75 billion. Results showed full acceptance for three series, while May 2028 Notes were prorated at 66.97% due to the sub-cap. Total consideration paid was about $4.898 billion. This debt repurchase reduces outstanding liabilities and interest expense. Watch for balance-sheet impact and any future liability management exercises.
